types.label: Email
types.description: Plain-text email sent through your own SMTP server (your mail provider, a transactional mail service, or your own relay).

fields.label: To
fields.help: One or more recipient addresses, separated by commas (at most 20).

fields.label: From address
fields.help: The sender address. Most providers only accept addresses on a domain you have verified with them.

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.help: Host name of your SMTP server. It must be reachable on a public address; private and internal addresses are refused.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: 25, 465, 587 or 2525. Leave blank for 587 (465 when security is TLS). Usually 587 with STARTTLS or 465 with TLS.

fields.label: Security
fields.help: STARTTLS: connect in plain text, then upgrade to TLS; fails if the server doesn't offer it. TLS: encrypted from the start (usually port 465). None: no encryption, for relays on a network you trust. Certificates are always verified.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Optional. Leave blank if your server accepts mail without logging in.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Required with a username; an app password or API key for most providers.

fields.label: Allow insecure authentication
fields.help: Off (recommended): the username and password are only ever sent over TLS, so with security None and a username the channel won't send. On: allow logging in over an unencrypted connection, where anyone on the network path can read the password.

types.label: ntfy
types.description: Push notifications to your phone or desktop via an ntfy topic (ntfy.sh or self-hosted).

fields.label: Server URL
fields.help: Leave blank for ntfy.sh. A self-hosted server must be reachable over public https on port 443 or 8443; private and internal addresses are refused.

fields.label: Topic
fields.help: Letters, digits, - and _ only. Topics on ntfy.sh are public to anyone who knows the name, so pick a hard-to-guess one or use an access token.

fields.label: Access token
fields.help: Optional. For protected topics: sent as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: Automatic: urgent for KEV or critical findings, low for resolved ones and recoveries.

types.label: Webhook
types.description: HTTPS POST of a JSON payload, signed with HMAC-SHA256.

fields.label: URL
fields.help: Public https endpoint (port 443 or 8443). Private and internal addresses are refused.

fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: Generated for you and shown once. Verify the X-Upkeep-Signature header with it (docs/WEBHOOKS.md).
